Small businesses · office managers · in French

Leave and absence tracker

For small French businesses without HR software: paid leave and time-off (RTT) balances computed day by day under the French Labour Code, with editable rules (reference period, accrual, sick leave, public holidays including Easter). Leave requests with a status (requested, approved, refused, cancelled), a team calendar and an alert when a team exceeds its maximum number of people away. Minimal employee data, no health details.
